text: INTERPRETER (lang-forms LF-1, `()` unit value): the parser builds `()` as the empty block `{}` (the node every engine already handles), so `Ok(())`, `let u = ()` and `return ()` now pass where they were E0000 parse errors; `() => e` stays a lambda. The interpreter's `()` pattern now matches the unit value: a `match` that passed check and panicked with `no match arm matched` now runs, and one with a fallback arm beside a `()` arm now takes the `()` arm (intended behaviour change, CHANGELOG). Native: a `match` on a value-less (unit) subject whose arms are all `()`/`_` now runs its first arm instead of running none; any other pattern there is refused with E0910 instead of being skipped. fmt prints the unit value as `()` in value position. The CS3-5 `()` parse-help row is deleted.
